chapter: Second session: boyhood, brothers and early road years
title: Richard's rotating barber chair and metal milk-bottle cap
summary: Richard invented a barber chair that travels around the customer and a metal snap cap for milk bottles that sold widely.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: And you showed me a picture of a barber chair with a rotating seat for the barber...
...so he'd be at the right level as he circled the person whose hair he was cutting.

Yeah, so he don't have to stand up. He cut the hair sitting down and travels all around. They tell me they got...my barber up here told me that they got it on the market now, but, you know, this was thirty...forty years ago when his was out. So they say they got one out on the market now that travels around the chair. So I never seen it but...oh, he got a lot of those things. He had beer tops, you know. Milk bottle tops. You know when you get the milk bottle you got a little old paper clip in there that you tip out and that thing gets nasty and everything, so he's got a metal cap that you slip on there and snap on there and you never did have all that old milk drying on there and getting nasty and dirty and everything, you see. And he sold a gang of those things, you know.
Sounds like a very good idea.
Yeah, it's just the same as...fits like...on the top just like any...the other paper one did only it's metal and it had snaps on it--a spring on each side. You snap it over the top

of the bottle, and 'course, it was always clean. You know how you buy...you used to buy milk in the bottle, and after you open it a couple of times, that thing gets all nasty and de...uh...it gets with pieces off it of the old paper, and it's a...but he fixed it so that you, when you bought your bottle of milk, you ...when you come home, you threw that away and you put your metal cap on it.
Sounds like he was always thinking.
I..I had one or two of them around here. I don't know whether I could find them or not.
